usage_note: get rid of + thing or person: 'I got rid of my old phone.'

context.text: Our flat was full of old furniture. Last weekend we finally got rid of the broken sofa.

particle_note: Separable: give away your books / give your books away; with a pronoun only give them away.

relations.note: Give to a charity or people in need.
Give one to each person in a group.

context.text: When I finished school, I gave my old textbooks away to younger students. My mother gives away clothes we do not wear.

reviewer_note: give away = tell a secret is a different meaning, not shown.

forms.example: She gave me a quick glance and smiled.

syn.note: The easiest word; can be long or short.

forms.definition: to look at something very quickly

ant.note: To look for a long time.
To look for a long time, often with love or surprise.

context.text: During the test, Aziza glanced at the clock. One quick glance told her she had ten minutes left.

reviewer_note: at a glance as a fixed phrase not split.

forms.definition: the world, or a round model of it
forms.example: There is a globe on the teacher's desk.

forms.definition: the way businesses and cultures become connected around the world

forms.note: globalize exists but is rare and formal.

forms.example: Climate change is a global problem.

syn.note: In all parts of the world.

forms.definition: in every part of the world
forms.example: The company sells its products globally.

context.text: Pollution is a global problem. Countries must work together globally to protect the planet.

reviewer_note: B1/B2 rows merged (world sense); global = overall (B2 technical) noted only.

particle_note: Not separable: go out with + person: 'She is going out with Timur.'

relations.note: Have a romantic relationship with someone.

context.text: My cousin has been going out with her boyfriend for two years. Now they want to get married.

reviewer_note: go out with friends (= leave home to have fun) is the literal meaning.

forms.definition: things that are made to be sold
forms.note: Always plural: 'the goods are', never 'a good'.

syn.note: Formal word for goods in shops.
Single things in a list or group.

ant.note: Work done for people, not things.

forms.note: Belongs to good = high quality, not things to sell.

context.text: The market in Chorsu sells all kinds of goods. Trucks bring the goods from the farms every morning.

reviewer_note: B1/B2 rows merged; good (adj) as other_meaning.

forms.definition: a small wound where skin is scraped
forms.example: He had a graze on his knee.
forms.note: Belongs to graze = scrape your skin, not animals eating grass.

forms.definition: to eat grass in a field
forms.example: Sheep were grazing on the hill.

context.text: In spring the shepherds take their sheep to the mountains. The animals graze there until autumn.

reviewer_note: grass is related in history but not shown as family.

forms.definition: a man on his wedding day
forms.example: The groom wore a dark blue suit.

ant.note: A woman on her wedding day.

forms.definition: to clean and brush an animal
forms.example: She grooms her horse every day.
forms.note: Belongs to groom = clean an animal, not the wedding.

context.text: At the wedding, the groom arrived with music and dancing. The bride and groom then cut the cake.

reviewer_note: bridegroom is a compound (Rule 7) given as synonym only.

forms.definition: things you do often and regularly, often without thinking

syn.note: Things you do at the same time every day.
Traditions of a group of people.

forms.note: inhabit (live in) is not made from habit.

forms.example: She habitually drinks tea at night.

context.text: Good study habits help students pass exams. My sister habitually reviews her notes before bed.

reviewer_note: Corpus headword is plural; the map keeps it and notes the singular habit.

forms.note: hand is the root but not a noun form of handy.

forms.example: A small torch is handy when the lights go off.
forms.note: Also: near and easy to reach ('Keep your phone handy').

context.text: This small bag is really handy for trips. It is handy because it fits all my documents.
